item.title: Oshino Hakkai: Eight Crystal-Clear Ponds Fed by Fuji Snowmelt — Guide
item.description: Oshino Hakkai is a set of eight spring-fed ponds of extraordinary clarity, filled by snowmelt from Mount Fuji that has filtered slowly through underground lava layers over many decades before emerging here, giving the water its famous transparency and vivid blue-green depths. Set within a traditional village of thatched-roof houses with Mount Fuji rising behind on clear days, the ponds are a designated Natural Monument and part of the mountain’s World Heritage listing, making a popular and highly photogenic stop between the Fuji Five Lakes.
